coverage_reasons: Section I, clause 6 – accidental external means (covers Grille, Front Door, Front Bumper, Painting and finishing, Labour charges)
Exclusion clause – wear and tear exclusion for Clutch plate wear

line_decisions.reason: The Company shall not be liable to make any payment in respect of … wear and tear, mechanical or electrical breakdown, consequential loss, and tyres unless the vehicle was damaged at the same time.

decision.summary: The claim is within the policy period and the loss is covered under accidental external means. All items are admitted except the clutch plate wear, which is excluded as wear‑and‑tear. Fraud risk is low, so the claim can be auto‑approved.

excluded.reason: The Company shall not be liable to make any payment in respect of … wear and tear, mechanical or electrical breakdown, consequential loss, and tyres unless the vehicle was damaged at the same time.

settlement.explanation:

  Painting and finishing: Rs 12,080  - 12.5% depreciation (Rs 1,510)  = Rs 10,570
